title: He Was Wrongly Convicted of Attempted Rape. He’s Suing the DNA Analysts.
summary: Alexis Rodriguez claims technicians at the New York City medical examiner’s office fabricated DNA evidence, leading to his wrongful conviction in 2014 for attempted rape.
